about: Invented expectations for the attached chats check in verify (P5-06). The questions are answered by the recorded turns in turns/attached-chats.json: the handoff's needs the summary of the chat it continues from in the call, which turns/recaps.json gives it; the attached chat's calls open_attached_chat. The held chat is the one of past-chats.json. The loader does not read this file and the binary does not embed it.

reply_contains: walking to the old lighthouse on Saturday
